## Description

Ranks markets by expected carry components such as yield differentials, futures roll yield or forward points, often diversified across assets.

## Where it may fit

Markets where carry compensation is positive and not overwhelmed by crash, funding or trend risks.

## Vehicles

Global macro, managed futures, FX, rates, commodity and multi-asset funds.

## Required data

FX forward points/yields, futures curves, bond yields, financing, collateral and synchronized spot/futures data.

## Caveats

Carry can be compensation for crash risk; risk-manage crowded exposures, correlations and abrupt deleveraging.
